# Trip.com

> > Trip.com is a global travel service platform offering train ticket booking across China, Europe, and worldwide, plus hotel property management solutions through the eBooking System.

Trip.com Group operates comprehensive travel services including high-speed rail ticketing for China, Hong Kong, UK, Europe, and South Korea, alongside B2B hospitality solutions. The platform serves both travelers seeking train tickets and hotel properties managing reservations, rates, and revenue through data-driven tools.

## Key Topics

- Train ticket booking
- China high-speed rail
- eBooking System
- Hotel property management
- Revenue management
- Reservation systems
- Shanghai-Guangzhou route
- European rail travel
- Asian train networks
- Merchant portal solutions
- Travel booking platform
- Hospitality software
- Dynamic pricing
- Trip.com Group services

## Train Booking Services

- [Global Train Tickets](https://bh.trip.com/trains/): Cheap train tickets across the world including UK, Europe, China, and South Korea
- [China High Speed Rail](https://bh.trip.com/trains/china/): Book Chinese Mainland and Hong Kong high-speed train tickets with instant e-ticket delivery
- [Shanghai to Guangzhou Train](https://bh.trip.com/trains/china/route/shanghai-to-guangzhou/): High-speed train tickets, schedules, and pricing for Shanghai-Guangzhou route

## Hotel Management Solutions

- [eBooking System](https://ebooking.trip.com/): Dynamic property management platform for hotels to manage reservations, room rates, availability, and revenue with data analysis tools
